method: Read-only source inspection. Alpha-composited black/grey/white review; robust least-squares alpha>128 deck silhouette edges; manual outer deck corner x picks with +/-3px uncertainty; shared camera-ppm/ground-origin fit to corresponding physical 8x6m deck z=0 points. Seat/head/entry projections derive from the supplied world guide; projections do not assert native visibility.
coordinateBasis: runtime local metres=(guide x,-guide y); heading=(camera beta - guide object theta -45)mod360

visualInspection.style: Consistent worn green/cream timber pavilion, rusty corrugated gable roof and timber deck; plausible old budget facility; empty seats, no stamped people.
visualInspection.sixPosts: Visible supports are consistent with the six-post guide topology; roof-hidden supports cannot be counted from painted views alone.
visualInspection.threeRows: Three parallel bench rows visible in normal corners and yaw E/W; yaw N/S third row is substantially roof-occluded.24seats are a model proposal, not validated individual usable native seat anchors.
visualInspection.twoRearEntries: Normal SW/NW and yaw S/W show both rear stair assemblies; yaw E one near-side assembly, with the other concealed. Normal SE/NE omit the small opposite-rear stair protrusion that is visible in the corresponding technical guide: left deck corner in SE, right corner in NE.
